theme_and_context.concept: The Sanctuary. A premium, high-converting luxury resort marketing and booking experience.
theme_and_context.vibe: Premium, trustworthy, calm, heavily rooted in nature and high-end editorial storytelling. Not a standard booking engine—a digital retreat.
theme_and_context.decision_rationale: Breaks the generic OTA (Online Travel Agency) booking pattern to feel unique for high-net-worth travelers. Uses cinematic immersion over dense forms.

typography.strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' strategy. Classic elegant Serif head paired with ultra-clean Mono/Geometric body.

headings.style: font-serif, tracking-tight, leading-none, font-light or font-medium. Massive scales (text-5xl to text-7xl for hero).
headings.notes: Never use Inter or Roboto for headings. Use fluid typography scaling.

body.style: font-sans, leading-relaxed, text-base, tracking-normal. Highly legible.

accents.style: Uppercase, tracking-[0.2em], text-xs to text-sm. Used for Overlines and Chapter numbers (e.g., '01 / THE SANCTUARY').

base.description: Cream/Off-White for light sections, Deep Forest Void for dark sections.

accents.description: Warm Wood/Terracotta (primary CTAs), Muted Moss (secondary blocks), Sand (borders/dividers).

rules.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA standards. DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for headers/dropdowns. Hover states must be a lighter/darker hue of the active state. Do not use generic full-screen gradients.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Glassmorphism ('Crystal' variant) for the sticky mobile CTA bar and fixed navigation (e.g., bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-white/20). Flat solid surfaces for content cards to retain a warm, physical feel.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle SVG noise or grain overlay (opacity-20 blend-overlay) across dark sections to make the forest green feel like velvet, not digital plastic.
visual_enhancers.shapes: Clipped frames with sharp corners or very slight radii (rounded-sm) to match the premium architectural vibe. Avoid bubbly/heavy rounded corners.

grids.strategy: The 'Tetris' Grid (Mode A) for the visual experience gallery.
grids.implementation: Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Mix spans (col-span-8, col-span-4) to create intentional asymmetry. Leave negative space. Never fill 100% of the grid perfectly.

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use py-24, py-32 for section pacing. Inside containers use p-8 or p-12.
layouts.alignment: Left-align paragraphs and dense content. Headings can be optically centered only in the Hero or distinct manifesto moments.
sections: Hero: Full viewport height (100vh), Kinetic text reveal, Infinity pool background.
Trust & Intro: The 'Manifesto' style, large serif text, slow editorial marquee.
Experience/Gallery: Asymmetrical grid with clipped image reveals.
Accommodation: High-contrast cards showcasing Bungalow/Valley View, etc.
Meal Plans & Enquiry: Clean Shadcn forms stripped of the 'Vercel' look, styled with earthy colors.
Sticky Bottom CTA: Mobile-only, fixed bottom, glassmorphic bar with WhatsApp and Call buttons.

motion.scroll: MUST use @studio-freight/lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. This is critical for the premium feel.
motion.hero_reveal: Framer Motion line-by-line masked text reveal on load. Wrap each line of text in an 'overflow-hidden' container and animate the child 'y' from 100% to 0%.
motion.parallax: Subtle parallax on the Hero image and large gallery images (y-axis translation on scroll) using Framer Motion's useScroll.
motion.micro_interactions: Image wrappers scale up slightly on hover (scale-105 duration-700 ease-out) while the wrapper stays overflow-hidden. Buttons use a fill-slide or text-shift hover effect.

accessibility.contrast: Always verify APCA contrast. Include text-shadow over images.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='whatsapp-enquiry-button').

media.image_handling: CRITICAL: The provided real photography has baked-in logos and Instagram tags. To handle this gracefully: Wrap images in an overflow-hidden div, apply object-cover and scale-[1.10] to crop the edges out. Apply a gradient scrim (bg-gradient-to-t from-black/60 via-transparent) to the bottom of the images to mask watermarks and ensure text readability.
media.hero_overlay: Max overlay opacity bg-black/40. If the image isn't visible, you're wasting it. Use gradient overlays for text contrast instead of flat blanket overlays.

image_urls.description: Infinity Pool - mountain view. Best for the main landing 100vh hero section.
Bedroom 'Majestic Retreat' - warm wooden bedroom interior with candlelight.
Café Bamboo - open-air café with bamboo.
Valley View - woman looking at misty valley with river.
Bungalow at dusk - Kerala-style bungalow with warm lights.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Not strictly necessary for the core layout given the strong photography, but Framer Motion (2.5D parallax) and Lenis (momentum scroll) will create the Awwwards-level kinetic depth required.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install the required libraries: framer-motion, @studio-freight/lenis, react-fast-marquee.
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for marketing sections. Only use Shadcn UI components for complex interactions like the Form, Accordion (FAQs), or Dialogs.
Use the provided image URLs exclusively. DO NOT use generic placeholders.
Apply 'scale-[1.10]' inside an 'overflow-hidden' container for all images to crop out the embedded logos/tags.
Ensure the hero text reveal uses Framer Motion. The text should be masked (overflow-hidden) and slide up line-by-line.
Implement a sticky mobile CTA at the bottom using backdrop-blur-xl and solid contrasting buttons for WhatsApp and Phone.
Build a slow editorial marquee that says something like 'THE SANCTUARY OF WAYANAD — DESTINA TOURS — UNPLUG AND RECONNECT' in a serif font, separated by elegant bullet points.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate (e.g., navbars, sticky elements).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). This breaks transforms. Add transitions to specific properties only.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the CSS file.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Include data-testid attributes on all interactive and key informational elements.
